newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zellweger says expects 1997 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Zellweger says expects 1997 profit rise.

text.p: Diversified engineering group Zellweger Luwa AG said it expected profit and sales to rise in 1997 after getting off to a good start in the first quarter.
"The current year has begun in a gratifying manner," it said in a statement.

"Order inflow was up around 10 percent in the first quarter compared with the year-earlier period. The Zellweger group expects an increase in order inflow and sales and a clear rise in profit in 1997." It did not elaborate.
Zellweger posted a group profit of 27.2 million Swiss francs in 1996 on sales of 1.06 billion.
